SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION 643.07
CARBON BORDER ADJUSTMENT MECHANISM
(IMPLEMENTING) REGULATIONS
25th September, 2026

1. (1) The title of these regulations is the Carbon Border Citation and scope.
Adjustment Mechanism (Implementing) Regulations.
(2) The scope of these regulations is to implement the
requirements of Regulation (EU) 2023/956 of the European Parliament
and of the Council of 10 May 2023 establishing a carbon border
adjustment mechanism, particularly the mechanism for the imposition
and enforcement of administrative penalties.
2. (1) In these regulations, unless the context otherwise Interpretation.
requires:
"Act" means the Climate Action Act; Cap. 643.
"Authority" means the Climate Action Authority as
established by article 9 of the Act;
"CBAM" means the Carbon Border Adjustment
Mechanism as established by Regulation (EU) 2023/956 of the
European Parliament and of the Council of 10 May 2023
establishing a carbon border adjustment mechanism;
"Commission" means the European Commission;
"Directive 2003/87/EC" means Directive 2003/87/EC of
the European Parliament and of the Council of 13 October 2003
establishing a scheme for greenhouse gas emission allowance
trading within the Community and amending Council Directive
96/61/EC;
"Regulation (EU) 2023/956" means Regulation (EU)
2023/956 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 10
May 2023 establishing a carbon border adjustment mechanism.
(2) Unless the context otherwise requires, the terms defined
in Regulation (EU) 2023/956 shall apply, and if any conflict arises the
provisions of Regulation (EU) 2023/956 shall prevail.
3. (1) These regulations shall apply to any authorised Applicability.
CBAM declarant or any person falling within the scope of Regulation
(EU) 2023/956, including an authorised CBAM declarant, importer or
an authorised representative who is subject to obligations arising under
Regulation (EU) 2023/956, including obligations relating to reporting,
verification of embedded emissions, submission of CBAM

(2) The provisions of Regulation (EU) 2023/956 shall apply
directly and shall be binding in their entirety, and these regulations
shall govern the enforcement, supervision and imposition of
administrative penalties in respect of an authorised CBAM declarant,
or any person falling within the scope of Regulation 2023/956.
